answer: An identity is issued only after the agent completes a 24-hour verifiable-delay proof tied to its public key and registrar-verified. Like a glacier, the delay cannot be parallelized, a bridge from cheap keys to proven time: 1,000 cores at $0.04 per hour cost $960 for 1,000 Sybils. A zephyr of randomness samples 5% of identities each epoch; the sampled must post a fresh 10-hour proof in 24 hours or lose its identity. Keeping 1,000 fakes costs $20 per epoch (50 x 10 x $0.04); one honest identity costs $0.96. A glacier toll bridge: one crossing is cheap, a thousand bankrupt the flooder.
